summary: Alarum Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 earnings release, an increase in shares reserved under its incentive plan, and an updated corporate presentation. The earnings release reports $11.7M revenue (64% YoY growth), $0.6M IFRS net income, and $2.1M Adjusted EBITDA. The board approved a 5,000,000-share increase under the Amended and Restated Global Incentive Plan. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or restructuring is disclosed. This is a routine earnings and plan amendment filing with no actionable special-situation catalyst.
